admitted_claim: M139 prevents reset-epoch alias only when macro_flush_ack truthfully denotes that all stale responses have been drained and cannot later reappear.

p1.name: false wrapper completion alias
p1.attack: The external wrapper emits a syntactically valid low-high-low flush acknowledgement without draining a stale token-0 response, then replays that response after RUN begins.
p1.observed_failure: The stale data can be paired with a new tag while protocol_error remains low.
p1.root_cause: M139 cannot independently observe physical completion across all external banks.
p1.required_fix: Implement and verify an actual 16-bank flush aggregator whose acknowledgement is derived from per-bank drain completion, then bind its proof to M139.
